step.action: Confirm the current speaker, control, antenna, cable, power, and audience-boundary plan in 📦 Build_Book.
Place and secure each sound component in its mapped position.
Inspect every power and signal cable for damage before connection.
step.ifThen: IF a cable has damaged insulation, plug, connector, or heat marks, THEN remove it from service.

step.action: Route cables clear of traffic, sharp edges, water, fuel lines, and tension.
Have the Power Lead connect the de-energized power system according to the approved plan.
Have the Sound Lead energize and test every approved channel at test volume.

passWhen.criterion: Every sound component is secured in its mapped position.
No damaged cable, exposed connector, blocked path, or unprotected crossing remains.
Every approved channel passes the Sound Lead's test.
